title: Heredity and Mendel’s Laws
summary: Genes and alleles, dominant and recessive traits, Punnett squares and Mendel’s pea experiments.
objectives: I can explain dominant and recessive alleles.
I can use a Punnett square to predict offspring ratios.
I can explain Mendel’s monohybrid and dihybrid results.
misconceptions: Children are a blend of their parents.
A recessive trait disappears for ever.
Dominant traits are always the most common.
